mapper.select: SELECT forecast_date, slot_hour, weather_code, SUM(vote_weight) AS score, COUNT(*) AS voter_count FROM weather_votes WHERE forecast_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY forecast_date, slot_hour, weather_code ORDER BY forecast_date, slot_hour, score DESC, weather_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weather_votes (user_id, forecast_date, slot_hour, weather_code, vote_weight) VALUES (#{userId}, #{forecastDate}, #{slotHour}, #{weatherCode}, #{voteWeight}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weather_code = VALUES(weather_code), vote_weight = VALUES(vote_weight), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO weather_vote_history (user_id, forecast_date, slot_hour, previous_weather_code, new_weather_code) VALUES (#{userId}, #{forecastDate}, #{slotHour}, #{previousWeatherCode}, #{newWeatherCode})
